terra.problem: The passage says the fugitives fled to a distant place, not that they ran as far as they could.
Papa says he hid in the drawer, but his backstory says he was placed there. The comparison also doesn't match the fleeing and capture: the fugitives did have somewhere to run.
Being captured without a bow does not establish that no fight was involved. Verse 2 describes the slain, not how the rulers were captured.
The text says the horsemen were posted at the gates, not that they were standing guard.
The text says the houses were torn down to strengthen the wall; it does not say they were used to patch it.
